To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the lecture based learning environment and the student centred learning environments are both less effective than the mixed learning environments consisting either of lectures and case-based learning used by turns or of gradually implemented case-based learning.

the lecture based learning environment, in contrast to the student centred learning and the gradually implemented case base learning environments, is not effective in promoting students' deep and strategic approach to learning.
student centred methods can optimise the surface approach, while the deep approach remains difficult to enhance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question how student centred teaching methods can optimise students' approaches to learn, in professional higher education.
the question whether and how student centred learning environments can optimise students' approaches to studying in professional higher education.
the development of a student centred curriculum in which case based learning is implemented.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the student centred learning approach is not the only way to enhance students' learning.
the deep approach is not a natural result of student centred instruction.
student centred teaching methods are not always the most effective way to optimise students' approaches to studying.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
student centred methods can be used to improve the learning process but they are not a panacea.
the deep approach is not a stable disposition but a fragile disposition. It can be easily influenced by the learning environment.
the student centered approach is not necessarily the most effective approach to teaching, and it may not be the most effective way to teach.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is important to be aware of the dynamics in approaches to studying when implementing student centred teaching methods.
the implementation of student centred learning is not a straightforward process.
it is important to be aware that students are not necessarily able to make the most of the educational opportunities offered to them.
